0.headingText: LifeKids is the children’s ministry of Life.Church for kids from birth-6th grade.
We’re dedicated to partnering with parents to lead children to become fully devoted followers of Christ.

00.content: Through age-specific lessons, activities, and small groups, children from birth-6th grade learn biblical truths and real-life lessons they can apply to their lives every week in LifeKids.
Save time when you check in your kids for the first time.

03.content: The Bible is the most amazing book ever written! We strive to creatively bring its stories to life through age-appropriate activities and discussions that keep kids engaged. We want every kid to love God’s Word and understand how to apply it to their life.

06.content: When you attend the same service each week, your child has the opportunity to build relationships with small group leaders and other kids. These relationships provide support and confidence, helping your child grow in their faith.

07.content: When kids have fun at church, they can’t wait to come back! And we know they'll have fun each week as they learn about who God is through games, activities, small groups, and video teaching.
